summary_en: 810,000 shares (1.66% of shares outstanding), ¥1.5B maximum, open-market acquisition via Tokyo Stock Exchange, July 1–August 31, 2026. Purpose: capital efficiency and stock option scheme funding.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: NS Group announced on June 23, 2026 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 810,000 treasury shares (1.66% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) with a maximum expenditure of ¥1.5 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between July 1 and August 31, 2026. The company states the purpose is to improve capital efficiency and to provide shares for its stock option (new share subscription rights) compensation program. As of May 31, 2026, the company held 3,469,400 treasury shares and had 48,686,200 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
